description: Digital Connectivity Indicators Maps, LGA, SA2, SUAs is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Bureau of Communications, Arts and Regional Research (BCARR). Indicator scores (0% to 100%) represent the level of digital connectivity in an area for each given technology type. Indicators depict the share of land area, or the share of premises, in a Local Government Area (LGA), Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2) or Significant Urban Area (SUA) where specific technology types are available. Coverage is Australia, 2024 to 2025; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-12-22. Files and pages listed: HTML, XLSX (4 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
